create_dashboard.name: Create dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Creates a managed Battman dashboard in the sidebar. Does nothing if one already exists; dashboards you have taken control of are never touched.

dashboard_unavailable.title: Battman could not create its dashboard
dashboard_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant's dashboard internals have changed, so Battman could not create its dashboard ({error}). Create it by hand: Settings → Dashboards → Add dashboard → New dashboard from scratch, then ⋮ → Raw configuration editor and replace everything with:

```yaml
strategy:
  type: custom:battman
```

missing_dependencies.title: Battman needs other dashboard cards

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: Battman {new} is installed, but Home Assistant is still running Battman {running}. Restart now to finish the update?

init.title: Battman entity map
init.description: Which entity (or event, file, pattern) each Battman name points at. Battman pages and views use these. Leave an entry as it is to keep Battman's default; changes apply the next time a Battman page or dashboard loads. In the solar string pattern, {marker} stands for the string number (1–12).
